gallery.title: File:120821-M-OT671-797 (7873533228).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Marine Corps Cpl. Jacob L. Nichols, with Marine Heavy Helicopter Squadron (HMH) 366, holds his 2-month-old son for the first time Aug. 21, 2012, after arriving at Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, N.C. Nichols and other Marines with his unit returned from a seven-month deployment to Afghanistan. (DoD photo by Lance Cpl. Andrea Dickerson, U.S. Marine Corps /Released)

gallery.title: File:'Til the Shooting's Done (10157855815).jpg
gallery.artist: Marines from Arlington, VA, United States
gallery.description:
Marines fire M9 pistols during the newly introduced Combat Pistol Program at Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, N.C., Oct. 3, 2013. CPP is being implemented throughout the Marine Corps and focuses on pistol marksmanship in combat situations. 

(U.S. Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Steve Acuff/Released)

gallery.title: File:100406-M-1155M-013 (4502794179).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: Lance Corporal Julian Taylor, a Personnel Clerk with Headquarters and Headquarters Squadron, receives a level 1 oleoresin capsicum contamination on April 6, 2010 aboard Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, North Carolina. Eleven Marines received the training as a part of the Security Augment Force to support MCAS Cherry Point's Provost Marshall Office. (Official Marine Corps Photo by Lance Corporal Robert J. Maurer) (RELEASED)

gallery.description: U.S. Marine Corps Cpl. Alexander Desir, an administrative specialist with the 24th Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU), hammers a tent stake into the ground during the set up of the MEU's communications exercise (COMMEX) at Camp Lejeune, N.C., March 29, 2016. The COMMEX was designed to refresh the skills of communications Marines and to ensure the equipment is fully functional. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Todd F. Michalek)

gallery.description: U.S. Marine Corps Sgt. Cameron C. Gump, an intermediate level structural mechanic assigned to Marine Aviation Logistics Squadron (MALS) 14, repairs an EA-6B Prowler universal exciter upgrade on Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, N.C., Nov. 20, 2015. gallery.title: File:140805-M-SW506-288 (14699356109).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Marine Corps Sgt. David R. Allen, left, a Marine Corps Water Survival Instructor assigned to Marine Wing Headquarters Squadron (MWHS) 2, and Chief Warrant Officer Kevin F. Kersey, right, a utilities officer assigned to Marine Wing Support Squadron (MWSS) 274, perform first aid on Lance Cpl. Austin J. Sona, a water support technician assigned to MWSS-274, during a Water Survival Advanced Course held at Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, N.C., Aug. 5, 2014. Allen and Kersey pulled Sona from the water after he experienced shallow water blackout. (DoD photo by Lance Cpl. Jodson B. Graves, U.S. Marine Corps/Released)

Austin Crowley, center, a combat engineer assigned to Marine Wing Support Squadron (MWSS) 274, swims 25 meters underwater during a Water Survival Advanced Course held at Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, N.C., Aug. 4, 2014. Students were tested on their ability to rescue distressed Marines in the water. (DoD photo by Lance Cpl. Jodson B. Graves, U.S. Marine Corps/Released)
